## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.10

v1.2.10 completes the current Rune Stats & Status Content layer. It adds server-authoritative click/poison combat handling, structured rune effects and targeted power, reward modifiers, updated rune/status commands, optional-client compatibility, and the runtime fixes accepted during final validation.

### Added
- Expanded rune stat content for the current damage, vulnerability, reward, and utility families.
- Added structured composite effects for click proc, delayed multipliers, temporary all-damage multipliers, and enhancement-related special effects.
- Added targeted rune power effects with final-value tooltip output.
- Added server-authoritative Poison status ticks separate from click damage.
- Poison now damages every active managed mob within a 2.0-block radius of the player on each status tick.
- Added Hidden Strike Glove proc behavior: fixed 15% chance with a base x2 multiplier; the multiplier scales with rune rank and enhancement.
- Added Rage Amulet behavior: valid mob clicks activate a 5-second all-damage multiplier; the multiplier scales with rune rank and enhancement, uses one stack, and refreshes duration on a new valid hit.
- Added coin reward and rune-resource reward modifiers to mob rewards.
- Added `/customrunes resetenhancements` and the matching admin-panel enhancement reset action.
- Added optional-client compatibility so players without `customguimod` can connect without receiving custom GUI/HUD/rune sync packets.

### Changed
- User-facing legacy `cards/deck` command terminology was replaced with `runes/status`.
- Rune tooltips now show final values with rank/enhancement scaling for the supported v1.2.10 effects.
- Reward modifiers are restricted to their intended targets: coins for coin reward, and `rune_dust`, `rune_shards`, `rune_cores` for resource reward.
- Crystals and compensation grants remain unaffected by rune reward modifiers.
- Poison targeting no longer tracks a selected or nearest mob; it uses the accepted 2.0-block area behavior.

### Fixed
- Fixed the currency panel background in the rune GUI.
- Removed repeated `getCardsInDeck: loaded ...` INFO logging that could spam the server console during regular status processing.
- Guarded custom packet synchronization for clients that do not have the mod installed.
- Preserved kill/reward handling for server-authored Poison damage while preventing click-combat recursion.

### Other
- The current damage channels are Click, Poison, Burning, Bleeding, Curse, Wither, and Decay.
- Runtime validation covered proc/rage scaling, Poison ticks, two-block area targeting, reward modifiers, optional-client connection, log cleanup, and the currency panel fix.
- Release metadata is aligned to `1.2.10`.
- The next planned development stage is v1.2.11 Large Number System.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.10.jar` on clients that need the custom GUI/HUD/rune features and on the server. Clients that do not need those client-side features may connect without `customguimod`.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.9...v1.2.10](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.9...v1.2.10)
